GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 2 Lengths 800m lead off rail .5 Lengths home turn lead Middle Of Track Straight Kept Going Too Well # on pace/held on
Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 6.5 Lengths rail turning, Made Some Ground inb Straight # never a threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped a runner. Shortly thereafter, was unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters on two occasions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced 2nd last 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace &out Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & laid in but worked home OK in last 150m. # Last 150m OK.

Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing a half length, Moved Up to Two Wide joint Lead turning, narrowly Headed Straightening Up , took Lead at the 300m, Headed 200m out and lost a length or So to the line # faded last bit
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 100m, was directed out around heels to continue into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled back 2nd last Two Wide 10 Lengths 600m, came widest from the corner, chased home strongly last 200m without getting into the race # chased home hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Blundered on jumping and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length on fence, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 900m was steadied for a number of strides when awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Four Wide , Drifted Back to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, steered out past centre of track Straightening Up and Held Ground in straight. (Winkers AGAIN) # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover Just off speed 3 Lengths 800m, did not finish race off in Straight # did not finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Blundered on jumping & Settled Down Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , maintained 2nd place to trail 2.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, lost a little ground in straight. (Ear Muffs OFF FIRST TIME, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) FIRST TIME, Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) # no excuses
Jumped okay & Went Forward to 0.75 Lengths joint Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led by a head turning, Headed 250m and lost a length to the line # led/faded late

Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, Moved Up to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Ground in straight. [Stewards: COT - To be ridden conservatively early to settle midfield. Settled handily. # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics – ridden conservatively early to settle midfield, settled handy. Bumped on jumping.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Four Wide , Moved Up to 1 length 3 Wide turning, shifted Four Wide rounding turn then Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # never on track
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced four wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. A post-race veterinary examination of the filly did not reveal any abnormality.
